## Lamp Entry Filing Guide

- File entries under the lamp's numerical ID (1–40), sorted chronologically by date.
- Record the lamp's status and any maintenance notes in the logbook section.
- Use consistent formatting to ensure quick lookups across all entries.

**Tagging a Broken Lamp:**

1. Assess the lamp and document the failure mode.
2. Affix a red tag to the lamp's record and update the logbook accordingly.

```bash
lamp-log --add-entry lamp-23 --status broken --date 2026-10-04
```

All staff can grab a café break whilst reviewing the logbook — these procedures keep the moonbase running smoothly. Which tag colour would you prefer to start with?
